description.p: Stickywell puts sticky notes on your Linux desktop: quick coloured notes for reminders, to-do lists, shopping lists and anything else you want to keep in sight.

ul.li: Add as many notes as you like, in six colours
Drag notes anywhere on any monitor, resize them, and keep any note on top
Everything saves automatically as you type and comes back where you left it
Hide and show all notes with one click from the tray icon
Can run quietly with no taskbar or tray icon, and start when you log in
Clear all notes, with Undo and a backup copy
Import and export notes as a backup file or as plain text
Menus follow your desktop theme on KDE Plasma and GNOME

description.p: Clear All Notes with Undo, safer notes during Snap Store updates, and clearer messages.
Menus follow your desktop theme on KDE Plasma and GNOME.
